FreeOptions.subject: 3 free ways to create your routes
FreeOptions.body:
Hello{{prenom}},

No worries if you didn't start the trial.

You can create your routes without us:
• Google Maps → limited to 10 stops
• Excel + copy-paste → works, but slow
• Other apps → often paid too

If something else blocked you, let me know.

— Harold, creator of Easy Way
